profile_text.body:
Technology Innovation Institute is a government laboratory founded in 2020 and not for profit. It is the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council. Its website centers on Falcon LLM, a generative large language model that the institute describes as making advanced AI accessible and available to everyone, everywhere, and helping to future-proof the world. The institute also announced the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit dedicated to advancing open-source generative AI models and building sustainable ecosystems around open-source projects.

The Falcon (TII) product is a UAE-hosted open-source LLM with an Apache 2.0 license, Middle East data residency, and sovereign AI. The site lists multiple Falcon models: Falcon-H1 and Falcon-E as the latest additions; Falcon Perception, a multimodal model combining vision and language; Falcon Arabic for Modern Standard Arabic and dialects; Falcon H1R 7B for reasoning in mathematics, coding, logic, and instruction-following; Falcon Mamba 7B, described as the first open source released State Space Language Model; Falcon 2 11B, an open-source, multilingual, and multimodal model with vision-to-language capabilities; Falcon 180B with 180 billion parameters trained on 3.5 trillion tokens; Falcon 40B with 40 billion parameters and one trillion tokens, described as the first home-grown open source LLM released with weights for research and commercial use; and Falcon 10B. The site states that Falcon-H1 outperforms Meta's LLaMA and Alibaba's Qwen, that Falcon 2 11B outperforms Meta's Llama 3 8B and performs on par with Google Gemma 7B as independently verified by Hugging Face Leaderboard, and that Falcon 180B is at the top of the Hugging Face Leaderboard for pre-trained Open Large Language Models. AI71, launched by Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council and VentureOne, issued a call for proposals using Falcon 10B.

No lawsuits or MCP servers are listed for the company.
